coder_notes: Paediatric/young-adult (1-21 years) vaccine pilot; stdAges CHILD, ADULT (mixed age). GBM named in conditions and inclusion list among other CNS tumours. Only vaccine-related agents (SurVaxM peptide vaccine, Montanide ISA 51 adjuvant, sargramostim as immune adjuvant), so no pharmacological candidate; sargramostim role flagged uncertain. Survivin expression required for relapsed/progressive strata (target of the vaccine, not a candidate, so not candidate-matched); H3K27M required only for atypical pontine lesions in DIPG stratum; H3K27M-altered DMG outside pons is excluded. Treatment setting 'both': relapsed strata plus newly diagnosed DIPG stratum (GBM patients are relapsed/progressive).
